source_row.extraction_instructions: Single server-rendered page; ~75 cards (div.filterData.list-item, client-side jplist filter, no pagination) with date(s), time, city or venue, type/category tags, title, short description. Every card links OUT to a third-party page, hrefs repeat across dates, so list_shells_override gives each shell a stable identity URL <listing>#evt-<hash> and extract_detail returns the real link as booking_url. The flagship Critical Care Congress is not a card; it is added from /annual-congress/critical-care-conference. Card types map: Hosted Training->course, SCCM Congress (pre-Congress sessions)->workshop, Webcast->workshop/online, Non-SCCM Event->conference. No fees on the site pages (Congress registration is on Cloudflare-blocked eventscribe), so pricing_tiers is []. Use bare host sccm.org; www.sccm.org does not resolve everywhere. Third-party (Non-SCCM) conferences use their own external URL as source_url; the Congress abstract status is read from its abstracts page (closed 2026-09-03).

concerns: Recon said ~244 events; the page holds 75 cards (all upcoming) plus the Congress page = 76 shells. The page states no total, so 75 is the count of cards on the page, not a proven site total.
No pricing anywhere: card pages are third-party and Congress registration is on congress2027.eventscribe.net, which returns a Cloudflare 403 to my IP. pricing_tiers is [] for all 76.
Each slow-path event navigates the browser to the 300KB listing (#evt-hash) and parses from the shell payload; harmless but redundant. Fast-path skip keeps steady-state loads low.

Card href (booking_url) targets are third-party sites; several (eventscribe, Facebook, Zoom) are not scraped, only linked. 15 pre-Congress sessions are separate workshop rows (they have separate times/prices).
Hosted-training descriptions are deterministic templates from title + category (listing has none); host contact details on the cards are deliberately dropped as personal data.
Event identity hash = title|start|end|time|location|category; if SCCM edits any of those, the old row stops being seen and a new one appears (old one is archived by the unseen-14d rule).
Congress abstract submission closed 2026-09-03, so abstract_open False and no deadline recorded. CPD only parsed for SCCM-hosted webcast pages (ACE credits); other events None.
Flagship shell is built from the Congress page's hero date line; if SCCM restructures that page the flagship is dropped with a warning (calendar cards unaffected).
www.sccm.org did not resolve from my machine; the extractor uses and rewrites to bare sccm.org. source_row.base_url should be the bare host as given.

Audit fix 2026-10-04: abstract_open now only comes from the event's own page. The 9 third-party conferences use their own external URL as source_url (was the shared listing, whose Congress text made the remediator mark them open); the Congress abstract deadline 2026-09-03 is parsed from /annual-congress/abstracts-and-case-reports (closed, so False). All other cards are False.
